task_definition.task_description: Please look up Alice’s contact details and confirm the right directory identity for her, then check the weather in New York and get the details for Hilton Tokyo. After that, prepare a deluxe room availability request for Alice Johnson for March 10–12, 2026, get the New York weather alert card and archive it for Alice as “NYC Travel Weather Archive” in the app with medium priority, then check flight AA100, book Alice Johnson on it in business class if it’s on time, and send Alice a high-priority app notification that the flight was booked successfully.
